PrdDocumentV3.description: PRD v3 uses contiguous function-specific sections, optional typed diagrams, embedded or later acceptance, and the same complete safety, table, citation and semantic-reference validation.

PrdInlineMarks.description: Inline marks are unique; enforced by the runtime Zod contract.

PrototypeDocument.description: Prototype screens, nodes, states, actions, bindings, assets, tokens, and motions form a valid semantic graph; enforced by the runtime Zod contract.

PrototypeExpression.description: Prototype expressions use only the declared operators, at most eight levels and 64 total nodes, and one to sixteen operands per and/or. A bounded pre-parse walk enforces tree limits before structural parsing; variable references and operand/result types are checked by the Prototype document contract.

inputType.description: date inputs bind an empty string or a canonical YYYY-MM-DD calendar date; locale dates, timestamps, and timezone suffixes are invalid

PrototypeOpenUrl.description: Prototype external navigation is restricted to canonical HTTP(S), mailto, and tel URLs; stricter mail recipient, query, and telephone syntax is enforced by the runtime Zod contract.

PrototypeRotation.description: Clockwise node rotation in degrees, normalized to the half-open interval [-180, 180)

values.description: A Prototype state defines at most 200 explicitly named runtime values; enforced by the runtime Zod contract.

PrototypeStateOverride.description: A state override changes at least one property in addition to nodeId; enforced by the runtime Zod contract.

PrototypeTransformOrigin.description: Rotation origin as normalized fractions of the node border box: (0,0) is top-left and (1,1) is bottom-right

screenIds.description: Screen ids within one Artifact target are unique; enforced by the runtime Zod contract.

RuntimeArtifactDraft.description: A PRD draft's top-level citations exactly match its content citations; enforced by the runtime Zod contract.
